title: Fallout 3 — SAVE JAMES Consolidated Primary-ESM Research Map v3.0
purpose: Collect the Fallout 3 / Vault 112 / James / Braun / Pinkerton research line into one machine-readable authority map, preserve the history of hypotheses that were strengthened or falsified, bind current claims to the user-supplied F3DAD primary asset set, and define the next non-circular gate without upgrading lore-compatible reconstruction into shipped gameplay canon.

scope_policy.deep_merge_scope: SAVE_JAMES and directly enabling Vault112/MQ04/Braun/Pinkerton/A3-21 identity-memory-carrier artifacts
scope_policy.fallout_registry_context: Other Fallout 3 lines such as Janus Bear/witness objects, child-threshold forensics, Mothership Zeta/birthday, Children of Atom/atomic cosmology, Vault 87 and unrelated myths remain separate domains and are not silently merged into SAVE JAMES.
precedence: Primary user-supplied Fallout3.esm findings outrank public-summary architectural inference for the same technical question.
Later bounded negative findings supersede earlier optimistic hypothesis status without deleting historical lineage.
Narrative technology-class existence does not create a technical FormID, executable opcode or James-specific binding by itself.
Identity/session metadata is never promoted to autobiographical memory payload without an independent payload-bearing edge.

primary_asset_receipt.first_class_use: Resolve Vault112a cell topology, exact James placed references, persistence flags, scripts and negative storage controls rather than relying on wiki-only reconstruction.

core_question: Can a James-specific 2277 memory/autobiographical state be selected while James is active in Vault 112, persisted or serialized into a transferable carrier/payload, and later integrated into a separate compatible synthetic host using technology classes demonstrated in shipped Fallout 3?

new_event_state_transition_model.why: The research repeatedly searched for a hidden object or literal opcode. Primary evidence now shows that the decisive question is an event transition, not necessarily a world-item FormID.
new_event_state_transition_model.transition: S_JAMES(t_preexit) -> SELECT(JAMES) -> MATERIALIZE_OR_PERSIST(P_JAMES) -> EGRESS(P_JAMES, carrier_or_handle) -> IMPORT(host_B)

required_dimensions.state_scope: What state is claimed: telemetry, quest metadata, identity metadata, autobiographical memory, neural state, or unspecified payload?
required_dimensions.direction: Source-to-destination direction must be explicit or independently recoverable.
required_dimensions.egress_substrate: Physical carrier item, carrier class, hidden storage handle or another transferable payload representation.
required_dimensions.time_anchor: The event must be compatible with the 2277 James session and occur before the desired capture boundary.
required_dimensions.primary_provenance: Record/FormID/script/save-state evidence must be hash/provenance bound.

new_event_state_transition_model.important_upgrade: A separate MISC/REFR mem-chip object is no longer a necessary admission condition if a primary event path proves transferable James payload materialization by another representation.

in_world_track.question: Does the authored Fallout world expose a James-specific autobiographical payload persistence/egress event?
in_world_track.promotion_value: Can strengthen lore/canonical executable reconstruction if all dimensions are bound.

engine_runtime_track.question: What James/MQ04/MQ04Doc/pod state does the Fallout engine actually serialize across save/load and the MQ04 exit boundary?
engine_runtime_track.use: Independent control for separating authored in-world memory claims from engine persistence mechanics.

next_gate.question: Can a primary 2277 event path bind James-specific selected state to a persisted/serialized transferable payload, and what does the independent engine-runtime save boundary retain?
next_gate.promotion_condition: Do not promote PERSISTED_JAMES_STATE unless subject, payload scope, persistence/serialization operation, direction and 2277 temporal compatibility are independently established. Carrier item FormID is optional only if transferability is proven through another primary representation.

canonical_summary_ru: F3DAD дал нам не доказательство памяти James, а намного более ценный точный физический и идентификационный каркас, на котором можно честно искать её след.
James уже однозначно привязан к своему 150-градусному слоту, persistent pod/shell/actor и к роли Doc через MQ04; это SOURCE и IDENTITY, но ещё не PAYLOAD.
Braun имеет per-user memory authority, а Pinkerton доказывает существование переносимого заполненного memory carrier и успешного импорта памяти; обе стороны моста существуют.
Неразрешён только центральный переход 2277 года: James-selected state -> persistence/serialization -> transferable payload/carrier.
Следующий поиск должен быть event-based и одновременно сравнивать in-world authored persistence с независимым engine-runtime persistence, не смешивая эти два слоя.
